turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a great way to get some energy flowing. Are you planning to spend any time in your shop today doing some woodworking?

turns.text: She's doing great! She's tackling some of her own things this afternoon, but we're going to hang out later. Tonight we are planning to relax and watch a nature documentary.

turns.text: A nature documentary is a wonderful choice for a relaxing Sunday evening. Do you two have a specific one lined up, or will you just browse?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We'll probably browse a bit, but we usually look for anything narrated by David Attenborough. His voice is just so soothing.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: He really is the gold standard for those! It sounds like a lovely, balanced Sunday. How are things going at school with your chemistry classes lately? I imagine the energy is high with the school year winding down.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, absolutely. Teaching high school chemistry this time of year is a real test of patience as the students get summer fever, but we're getting through the final labs. Today is a much-needed break from all the grading!
